blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Metro Manila and most parts of the country may experience generally fair weather on Sunday, Nov. 15, as the northeast monsoon, or the amihan, weakens, the state weather reported. In its 5 p.m. weather forecast, the Philippine Atmospheric, Geophysical and Astronomical Services Administration (Pagasa) said that hot and humid weather with a chance of localized thunderstorms may affect Metro Manila and the rest of the country. The weather bureau reported that the isolated rain showers expected to prevail midday on Sunday is due to the easterlies.
